summary: BioCardia filed an 8-K on October 7, 2026 solely to furnish a press release (Exhibit 99.1) announcing that a scientific poster on the CardiAMP HF II trial design will be presented at the Heart Failure Society of America Annual Scientific Meeting in Phoenix from October 9-12, 2026. The trial is a multicenter, double-blind randomized controlled study of autologous cell therapy in HFrEF patients on guideline-directed medical therapy with elevated heart-stress biomarkers. No transaction, ownership, capital, governance, or meeting matters are implicated. The filing is a routine current report under Items 8.01 and 9.01, so no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
